title: PHOENIX and TERN: a protocol-driven framework for task-based human-AI software-development studies
description:
PHOENIX connects study design, participant capture, and analysis handoff through a single versioned YAML protocol. Researchers design and review a study in a web workspace; TERN runs the configured session in VS Code; the server joins editor events, surveys, and optional external measurements into one dataset for export to a notebook.

Because capture configuration and the analysis plan are derived from the same protocol, a planned measure cannot go unrecorded and an analysis cannot be planned over data the study never collects.

This release contains no human-subjects data. Synthetic dry-run rows are labelled at ingest and every report or figure computed from them is marked as not a research finding.
